title: Defend the Big Blind With a Plan
description: Use price, position, and stack depth to build a disciplined big blind defending range.
body: Start with the price you are being offered, then account for the opener's position, range, and the effective stack. A marginal hand can be a profitable defend against a wide button range while remaining a clear fold against an early-position open.
exampleSpot: At 24 BB effective, Hero is in the big blind facing a 2.1 BB button open. The late-position range and immediate price support defending more hands than against an early-position open.
mistake: Using one fixed big blind range without adjusting for opener position, sizing, or effective stack.
betterPlay: Build the decision from pot odds and range interaction, then tighten or widen for the actual opener and stack depth.
whenToUse: When the effective stack allows postflop play
whenNotToUse: When the stack creates a cleaner reshove-or-fold decision
takeaway: Big blind defence is a price-and-range decision, not a fixed hand chart.
